#!/bin/bash -xe
# Install required packages
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y build-essential git cmake libssl-dev curl

# Set up Intel SGX
mkdir -p /opt/intel
cd /opt/intel
wget https://download.01.org/intel-sgx/sgx-linux/2.14/distro/ubuntu20.04-server/sgx_linux_x64_sdk_2.14.100.2.bin
chmod +x sgx_linux_x64_sdk_2.14.100.2.bin
echo -e 'no\n/opt/intel' | ./sgx_linux_x64_sdk_2.14.100.2.bin
source /opt/intel/sgxsdk/environment

# Clone project repository
mkdir -p /opt/rhombus
cd /opt/rhombus
git clone https://github.com/rhombus-tech/tee-integration.git
cd tee-integration

# Configure TEE node
export TEE_TYPE="SGX"
export TEE_ID="sgx-$(hostname | cut -d'-' -f2)"
export REGION_ID="us-east-1"

# Set up parameter validation for WebAssembly
mkdir -p /opt/rhombus/param-validation
cat > /opt/rhombus/param-validation/config.json << 'EOF'
{
  "validation": {
    "length_prefixed": true,
    "direct_format": true,
    "max_param_size": 1024,
    "format_detection": true
  },
  "cross_attestation": {
    "enabled": true,
    "partner_type": "SEV",
    "verification_ms_target": 100
  }
}
EOF

# NASDAQ Connector Setup
export NODE_TYPE="CONNECTOR"
export NODE_ID="nasdaq-connector"
export REGION_ID="us-east-1"

# Get instance metadata
PRIVATE_IP=$(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/local-ipv4)

# Create configuration for TEE communication
mkdir -p /opt/rhombus/mesh
cat > /opt/rhombus/mesh/connector_info.json << EOF
{
  "connector_type": "NASDAQ",
  "connector_ip": "$PRIVATE_IP",
  "connector_port": 9092,
  "region": "us-east-1"
}
EOF

# Start TEE services
cd /opt/rhombus/tee-integration
./setup.sh

#!/bin/bash -xe
# Install Kafka client
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y openjdk-11-jdk
mkdir -p /opt/kafka
cd /opt/kafka
wget https://downloads.apache.org/kafka/3.2.3/kafka_2.13-3.2.3.tgz
tar -xzf kafka_2.13-3.2.3.tgz
cd kafka_2.13-3.2.3

# Set up NASDAQ Kafka connector
cat > /opt/kafka/kafka_2.13-3.2.3/config/nasdaq-connector.properties << 'EOF'
bootstrap.servers=NASDAQ_KAFKA_ENDPOINT:9092
key.converter=org.apache.kafka.connect.storage.StringConverter
value.converter=org.apache.kafka.connect.storage.StringConverter
tasks.max=1
EOF

# Set up NASDAQ ITCH converter
mkdir -p /opt/rhombus/itch
cd /opt/rhombus/itch
git clone https://github.com/rhombus-tech/nasdaq-itch.git
cd nasdaq-itch
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Start market data processing service
cat > /etc/systemd/system/market-data.service << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=NASDAQ Market Data Processing
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
WorkingDirectory=/opt/rhombus/itch/nasdaq-itch
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 itch_processor.py
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable market-data
systemctl start market-data
